name: Enovis Corporation
summary: Enovis Corporation, a medical technology company, focuses on developing clinically differentiated solutions in the United States and internationally. It operates through two segments: Prevention and Recovery, and Reconstructive segments. The Prevention and Recovery segment offers rigid and soft orthopedic bracing, hot and cold therapy, bone growth stimulators, vascular therapy systems and compression garments, electrical stimulators for pain management, and physical therapy products which are used by orthopedic specialists, surgeons, primary care physicians, pain management specialists, physical therapists, podiatrists, chiropractors, athletic trainers, and other healthcare professionals to …
